test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rural infrastructure development is crucial to improve connectivity and access to markets and services. Which scheme focuses on providing all-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations?

options.text: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):** This scheme was launched in **2000** by the Government of India to provide **all-weather road connectivity** to unconnected villages in rural areas.
 
• **Objective:** The main aim of PMGSY is to enhance rural connectivity, which is crucial for improving access to **markets, education, healthcare, and other services**.
 
• **Scope:** The scheme focuses on villages with a population of **500 and above in plain areas** and **250 and above in hilly, tribal, or desert areas**. Hence, it targets the most remote and underserved regions.
 
• **Funding:** PMGSY is a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme**, with funding shared between the **Central Government and State Governments**. The funding ratio differs based on the type of state (e.g., 60:40 for most states and 90:10 for Himalayan and Northeastern states).
 
• **Implementation:** The scheme is implemented by state governments through the **Rural Development Department**. A detailed project report (DPR) is prepared for each road project, ensuring quality and sustainability.
 
• **Impact:** PMGSY has significantly improved rural infrastructure, leading to better **economic opportunities, reduced migration, and enhanced living standards** in rural areas.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Schemes Mentioned in the Question:**

 
 
• **Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY):** This scheme, launched in **2014**, aims at the holistic development of villages by Members of Parliament adopting and developing model villages. However, it does not focus on road connectivity specifically.
 
• **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM):** This scheme, launched in **2011**, focuses on promoting **self-employment and skill development** among rural poor households. It does not address rural road connectivity.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY):** This scheme, introduced in **2015**, focuses on providing **affordable housing** to the urban and rural poor. It is not related to road infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Rural Connectivity:**
 
 
• **Geographical Constraints:** Areas with difficult terrain, such as hilly or flood-prone regions, face challenges in constructing all-weather roads.
 
• **Funding Issues:** Adequate funds are essential to ensure timely implementation and maintenance of roads.
 
• **Quality Concerns:** Ensuring the durability of rural roads is crucial, as poor-quality construction can lead to frequent repairs.
 
 
 
• **Important Facts about PMGSY:**
 
 
• **Phase-I:** Focused on providing connectivity to unconnected habitations.
 
• **Phase-II:** Launched in **2013**, it aimed to consolidate existing rural road networks.
 
• **Phase-III:** Initiated in **2019**, it focuses on upgrading rural roads for better connectivity to **grameen agricultural markets** and other essential services.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Rural Road Connectivity:**

 
 
• **Economic Growth:** Improved road connectivity facilitates the transportation of goods and enhances access to markets, boosting rural incomes.
 
• **Social Inclusion:** Better roads improve access to education and healthcare, reducing inequalities in rural areas.
 
• **Disaster Resilience:** All-weather roads ensure connectivity even during adverse weather conditions, aiding in disaster management.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Success:**
 
 
• **Bihar:** PMGSY has helped in reducing migration by improving connectivity to employment opportunities.
 
• **Rajasthan:** Improved rural connectivity under PMGSY has boosted tourism in certain remote areas.
